title: Alweda Moula Hussain
body:
Alweda moula hussain alweda moula
Hogaya veeraan phir aaj ghar mera
Dil kholkar hussain ka matam na kar sake
Matami rote hain sab hai yahi sada
1. Us gham naseeb bano e muztar ko royiye’
Jhoole ko dekh dekh ke asghar ko royiye
Jhoolna asghar ka wo yaad ayega
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Agha kaha hussain ko bhai bhi bolte
Khawish hai aakhri meti bhai kaho mujhe Aur phir abbas ne bhai kehdiya
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Apne watan se aaj liye sab ke dil ka chain
Sar pa udhao khaak ke jaate hain ab hussain
Ahle haram ke sath hai ashkoun ka qafela
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Choudha(14) sau saal baad bhi aankho’n me hai name
Zehra ki ye dua hai rahe shaad matami
Nasiraane shah ka hai martaba mila
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Dawar malak se bolenge turbat me matami
You’n gham kiya hussain ka fursat nahi mili
rate rahe hussain ko kab hamne ye kaha
Kalaam : Ustaad Janab Dawar Ali Dawar Sahab
